query_analysis.original_query: Outline an advanced process control system to stabilize the liquid discharge rate from a high-capacity separator during fluctuating feed conditions.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Design an advanced process control strategy to maintain a stable liquid discharge rate from a high-throughput separator unit under variable feed stream conditions, considering potential disturbances and control system requirements.

clarification_questions: What is the typical range of feed flow rate and composition variability?
Are there any specific constraints on the control system implementation (e.g., hardware limitations, response time requirements)?
What are the acceptable limits for liquid discharge rate fluctuations?
